title: ISO 8573-5:2025 — Compressed air — Contaminant measurement — Part 5: Oil vapour content
locator: Official abstract: oil vapour content measurement using pressurized sampling and gas chromatography, with sampling, evaluation, uncertainty and reporting in relation to ISO 8573-1 oil purity class.
notes: Oil-vapour method; not a substitute for the oil aerosol method in ISO 8573-2. Gaseous contaminant measurement may require a different analytical method.
